note: A REQUEST RAISED BY ANY EMPLOYEE (owner, 8 Oct) is told to everybody above them in the reporting line, the Branch Admins of their branch (including branches a Branch Admin looks after), and every role whose reach is the whole company (HR Admin, Company Admin, administrator — Roles & Permissions decides). In the bell and on Notifications. `request.raised` words every kind below it unless a kind is declared on its own.

request.raised.title: {what}: {code} · {name}
request.raised.audience: the requester's reporting line, their branch's Branch Admins, company-wide roles
request.raised.audience_note: Never the requester. One message per recipient, so nobody is skipped because a colleague was told first.

request_modules_note: The registers (config/modules.json keys) whose NEW rows are requests somebody approves. Add a key here to have its new rows told; nothing in code lists them.
